requirements: Create one complete four-sided premium picture frame as a reusable isolated object, viewed straight-on with no perspective distortion
The frame must read as physically three-dimensional: restrained bevels, plausible relief depth, material thickness and coherent self-shadowing
Use a refined lightly vintage material treatment in warm aged brass or muted gold; patina must be subtle and premium rather than distressed or theatrical
Integrate small star motifs as understated engraved, embossed or cast details so the stellar theme is recognizable only on a closer look
Keep stars subordinate to the frame architecture; the frame must not read as a marquee, trophy, casino prop or Hollywood sign
Use an elegant narrow-to-medium profile with generous central opening so framed content remains dominant
Favor restrained Art-Deco-adjacent geometry and crafted ornamental detail over botanical or floral decoration
Lighting must be physically coherent and soft, approximately from the upper left, with highlights and shadows consistent across all four sides
Preserve a clean transparent center opening and transparent exterior background with precise alpha edges
No broad external cast shadow beyond the object footprint; depth should primarily be communicated by the frame material and internal relief
Maintain natural small asymmetries and material variation without obvious repeated stamp patterns
Keep corner joins believable as one manufactured or crafted frame rather than four pasted strips
High source resolution sufficient for clean downscaling on desktop and mobile web surfaces
The object must remain visually refined when displayed around a medium-sized website photograph and must not overpower nearby serif typography
The source master may contain material and lighting because this asset is intentionally a raster original, not a recolorable mask
Visual review must compare the final source against the strongest existing Hall-of-Memory frame treatment and reject it unless the new result is visibly more coherent and premium
forbidden: No floral, laurel, acanthus, leaf, vine or botanical main motif
No oversized stars, dense star fields or mechanically repeated star borders
No marquee bulbs, neon, glitter, sequins or show-business signage
No text, lettering, initials, logo or watermark
No camera, lens, filmstrip, clapperboard or other literal photography iconography
No bright yellow gold, orange metallic saturation or gaudy polished-chrome appearance
No heavy baroque scrollwork, rococo overload or ornate mass that competes with the framed content
No flat CSS-like gradient geometry pretending to be physical depth
No hard sci-fi, futuristic HUD, gaming or space-interface styling
No perspective tilt, three-quarter view or visible scene/background behind the isolated frame
No opaque fill inside the central opening or outside the frame silhouette
No large blurred drop shadow extending far outside the frame
No accidental crop of the outer frame edges or corner ornaments
No assumption that mirroring, rotation or recoloring preserves the intended material and lighting
Do not reuse or retroactively promote any historical exploratory generated bytes as this final source master
